notes: 198 new portraits, six named faces changed, and portrait framing rebuilt. THE PICKER goes from 60 to 258: 98 Colonist (human) and 100 Synthetic (android) heads join the five existing groups. Same 393x397 RGBA as the originals, which were byte compared against the incoming pack and are identical, so nothing a player currently wears moves. CREDIT IS NOW PER GROUP rather than one line in the modal header. The header said 'Art by subotai' above everything, which was true at 60 and becomes a false claim the moment a second artist is in the set. Colonist and Synthetic credit gatlingart at https://gatlingart.itch.io/. SIX FACES: Captain Trisha McHallan to scan99, Rahtan to scan80, Father Xen to droid38, Jaquet unchanged, Guild Notary Ostrow to scan10 and Syndicate Proxy Vasari to scan31. That last pair also closed a collision nobody had filed: Rahtan and Vasari were both corpo7, so the Guild's factor and the Syndicate's proxy wore the same face in two different rooms. FRAMING WAS A CONSTANT AND SHOULD NOT HAVE BEEN. Every ring zoomed 1.55x anchored 37 percent down, which cropped the faces off art drawn tighter in frame than that assumes. The scan portraits now carry a measured head box and EVERYTHING ELSE RENDERS 1:1, no crop, which also fixes Mr. Flesh: his jar is 32x32 and the old zoom cut the glass off entirely, leaving brain matter with no jar around it. The droid set and scan31 are excluded from measurement because a machine bust, and one hooded bearded human, are head all the way down and the rule reads their narrow crowns as small heads. Found by rendering every portrait the rule zoomed past 1.25x and looking. CHAT AVATARS were pinned at 40px while the text beside them scaled with the A+ / A- control. They now scale off the same variable at base 52px, council room avatars at 34px. SERVER RESTART REQUIRED: the selectable set is read from disk at boot. Hard refresh.
